title: Tuesday · laptops, party posters, maths and Nevermoor
arrival: Answer attendance, then hand in any forms. Get ready for our morning laptop work.
note: Morning laptops are confirmed. Use the morning for selected SpacesEDU work and a 30-minute party-poster comparison. Maths follows recess. After lunch: French with Mr. Eckert, a quiet reset and Nevermoor from our printed Chapter 6 passage. No inequalities upload is required. Provincial Student Vote is planned for Thursday October 22; our voting slot is pending. Friday October 23 is a non-instructional day.

blocks.title: Laptops · SpacesEDU and party-poster comparison
blocks.notes: Laptops confirmed. Finish or improve selected existing SpacesEDU work, using the instructions and teacher feedback. Reserve 30 minutes within this block for comparing the group poster sets: visit all parties, record a proposal, who it could affect and a question, then compare two parties on the same issue using sources. Give every party equal attention. Keep individual ballot choices private and complete the voting-process reflection only after participating. No new home upload or inequalities upload is assigned.
blocks.firstAction: Open SpacesEDU and choose one unfinished task or post to improve.
studentSteps: Finish one selected task or post; check its instructions and feedback.
When your teacher signals, spend 30 minutes comparing the group poster sets.
Record one proposal, who it might affect and a question. Compare two parties on the same issue using sources.
Save your work and ask for help if needed.
blocks.firstActionKo: SpacesEDU를 열고 끝내지 못한 활동이나 게시물 하나를 골라 개선하세요.

blocks.title: Save work, put laptops away and snack
blocks.firstAction: Save your work and put your laptop away before snack.
blocks.firstActionKo: 작업을 저장하고 노트북을 정리한 뒤 간식을 먹으세요.

blocks.title: Maths · factors and prime factorization
blocks.notes: Continue the current factors and prime-factorization work using paper and pencils. Use the existing companion if a model is needed: compare trees for 24 beginning with 4 × 6 and 3 × 8. Keep repeated prime factors and check by multiplying back. Practise the teacher-selected examples from 18, 30 and 36; 60 is an optional challenge. Show and explain one tree independently. Do not assume all previous work is finished or introduce a new GCF investigation automatically.
blocks.firstAction: Get your current maths work, paper and a pencil ready.
studentSteps: Continue the maths practice your teacher selects.
Split factor trees until each end number is prime.
Check by multiplying all the prime factors back together.
Show one example you can explain independently.
blocks.firstActionKo: 현재 수학 활동과 종이, 연필을 준비하세요.

activity.label: Prime factorization · video, trees and practice

blocks.title: Lunch
blocks.notes: Usual intermediate routine: outside 11:50–12:12; transition 12:12–12:13; eating 12:13–12:35.
blocks.firstAction: Follow our outside-play and lunch routine.
blocks.firstActionKo: 바깥 놀이와 점심시간에는 정해진 순서대로 하세요.

blocks.title: Core French · Mr. Eckert
blocks.notes: French-only specialist block with Mr. Eckert.
blocks.firstAction: Get your French materials ready and follow Mr. Eckert’s directions.
blocks.firstActionKo: 프랑스어 준비물을 꺼내고 Eckert 선생님의 안내를 따르세요.

blocks.title: Quiet reset
blocks.notes: A calm transition after French; quiet non-reading choices are available.
blocks.firstAction: Choose quiet reading, drawing or an unfinished task.
blocks.firstActionKo: 조용히 책 읽기, 그림 그리기, 끝내지 못한 활동 중 하나를 고르세요.

blocks.title: English Language Arts · Nevermoor
blocks.notes: Continue the printed Chapter 6 Nevermoor passage from the actual class bookmark. Briefly recall the last part actually read; do not invent story events or assume the chapter is finished. Read or listen, identify a character or setting detail, and give an idea supported by that detail.
blocks.firstAction: Find our place in the printed Chapter 6 passage.
studentSteps: Read or listen from our actual Chapter 6 stopping point.
Notice a character or setting detail.
Write, draw or say an idea and the detail that supports it.
Mark where we stop and keep one question for next time.
blocks.firstActionKo: 인쇄된 6장 자료에서 지난번에 읽다가 멈춘 곳을 찾으세요.

blocks.title: Planners, jobs and cleanup
blocks.notes: Restore our room and record confirmed reminders.
blocks.firstAction: Restore our room and record any confirmed reminders.
blocks.firstActionKo: 교실을 정리하고 확정된 안내 사항을 적으세요.

blocks.title: Classroom community
blocks.notes: Use a short check-in, appreciation or familiar cooperative game. Students may speak, draw, point or pass; keep feedback specific and avoid public rankings.
blocks.firstAction: Notice one helpful action from today.
studentSteps: Offer one specific appreciation or listen.
Name a small next step for tomorrow.
blocks.firstActionKo: 오늘 도움이 된 행동 한 가지를 떠올려 보세요.

blocks.title: Pack up and dismissal
blocks.firstAction: Check your belongings and get ready for a calm departure.
blocks.firstActionKo: 자기 물건을 확인하고 차분히 하교할 준비를 하세요.

backups: If a laptop or login is unavailable, finish paper work or rehearse a spoken reflection. Ask for help rather than sharing account details.
Use printed poster sources for the comparison and record unanswered questions instead of guessing.
Use the on-page factor-tree model or draw trees for 24 on the board if the video is unavailable. Paper and pencils are enough.
Carry unfinished learning forward. No inequalities upload is required.
